lines: Your XP now adds up to a level, from one to thirty, and the header shows it on every screen.
Each level has a threshold: level two at four hundred XP, level eight at two thousand six hundred, level nineteen at ten thousand four hundred. The rest are provisional until the table is settled.
The mid rider reads level seven, eighteen forty of twenty-six hundred, the bar seventy point eight percent full. Tap it for Profile. On a phone, only the badge.
Every ride answers with the level it reaches and whether it went up. At level thirty, the XP keeps growing and the level stays put.
What the tests prove: every row of the table, the level through the API, and the header as the rider sees it.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
